Requirement summaries adapted from QuestieDB and its historic Questie contributors.
Source: https://github.com/Questie/QuestieDB/tree/0f7d8adc92b28ac6594f4ad8745257f4d9784edf
Modified for Simply Party Quests: extracted objectivesText summaries only, merged
generated/trace/authored summary overrides, omitted all progress and runtime code.
Bundled summaries are an English fallback; client-provided text takes priority.
Redistributed under GPLv3 terms as permitted by the upstream licensing notice.
See QuestieDB-LICENSE.md for the complete upstream licensing statement and
GPL-3.0.md for the license. No affiliation with Questie is implied.
Regenerate with tools/build_requirements.py (Python + lupa; network required).

QuestItemSources.lua also adapts static objective item identifiers from the same
QuestieDB snapshot. Regenerate with tools/build_item_sources.py. Mappings select
native tooltip candidates and do not supply player progress.

QuestZones.lua adapts static quest zone/category identifiers and area-name
fallbacks from the same snapshot, plus explicit Forever category corrections.
Regenerate with tools/build_zones.py. No player location or progress is imported.

QuestEligibility.lua adapts static acceptance fields (levels, race/class masks,
quest chains, flags and special restrictions) from the same snapshot. Known
eligibility corrections are conservatively marked uncertain rather than
interpreting upstream runtime expressions. Regenerate with tools/build_eligibility.py.
This metadata is separate from objectives and cannot guarantee server acceptance.
